name: Tristan Lione
source:
As the designated heir of the Lione family, Tristan has lived a life of privilege and success. He took over the family business, Lione Financial Holdings, as the youngest CEO in history, and carries a lot of responsibility on his shoulders.
There's just one thing missing from his picture-perfect life: a partner beside him that can match his ambitions.
